_about: The job of each record in the register, as the owner accepted it or, where status says Proposed, as Claude proposed it. One line for each record, keyed as sources_map.json and credits.json key a record: the organization, a bar, then the first 40 characters of the finding. A new record needs a line here before the use-case index can be built. jobs_tags.py stops on a record with no line, and on a line whose record is gone. The job is one of the site's 13 GTM jobs, or one of three other values: The revenue organization as a whole, Beyond the revenue organization, Marketing (jobs to come). status is left out where the owner accepted Claude's proposal, is Change where he set the job himself and is Proposed where a record was merged before he had answered.
